description: EV-EcoSim couples electric-vehicle charging infrastructure, storage and grid calculations for design and optimisation. The README supplies configuration instructions and identifies an associated publication. The provider is ebalogun01 (repository owner). Coverage: The platform uses scenario-specific charging and electrical-network inputs. Geographic coverage, dates and resolution depend on the configured case. Access: The provider publishes a metadata page describing the resource and its access route. Resource files were not downloaded or executed. Licence and cost: Code is MIT-licensed. The README requires Gurobi licensing and an Arras GridLAB-D installation for power-grid co-simulation. Limitations: The grid component is optional for non-voltage studies. Dependencies were not installed, and independent reuse or sustained maintenance was not established. For simulation it supports charging-station design with power-system voltage constraints. Related resources: The documented co-simulation depends on GridLAB-D, represented by model-gridlab-d.
